dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge following a non-linear spline with a slight indentation visible at the proximal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel radius forming a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin with a steep posterior inclination of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width exceeds vertical height with a ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a large radius transition from the dorsal ridge to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum profile with a length-to-depth ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle visible at the intersection of the melon's descent and the superior rostrum boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small circular pale depigmentation spots on the mid-lateral flank; a prominent V-shaped notch is present on the posterior margin of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly saturated cyan/teal chromatic profile across the dorsal and lateral tegument.
